chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, all together from Ibn Mahbub, from al-Haysam ibn Waqid al-Jazari, who said:
I heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent a Prophet from among His Prophets to his people, and revealed to him: “Say to your people:”

There are no inhabitants of a town nor any people who were upon My obedience and were granted ease therein, then changed from what I love to what I dislike, except that I change for them from what they love to what they dislike.

And there are no inhabitants of a town nor any household who were upon My disobedience and were afflicted therein by hardship, then changed from what I dislike to what I love, except that I change for them from what they dislike to what they love.
And say to them: ‘My mercy has preceded My wrath, so do not despair of My mercy, for no sin is too great before Me for Me to forgive it.’

And say to them: ‘They must not expose themselves, in stubbornness, to My anger, nor belittle My Awliya’, for indeed I have assaults at the time of My anger that nothing from My creation can withstand.’

key_terms.أَوْلِيَائِي: Allah’s chosen friends and loyal servants
key_terms.رَحْمَتِي: Allah’s mercy, which remains open to the repentant
key_terms.سَطَوَاتٍ: overwhelming acts of seizing or punishment
key_terms.طَاعَتِي: obedience to Allah in conduct and devotion
key_terms.غَضَبِي: Allah’s wrath against persistent rebellion and defiance
key_terms.لَا تَقْنَطُوا: do not despair or lose hope
key_terms.مَعْصِيَتِي: disobedience and sin against Allah’s command

ai.seo_question: How does Allah change a people’s condition according to their obedience, disobedience, and repentance?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that divine blessings and hardships are linked to people’s moral and spiritual state: obedience followed by disobedience leads to loss, while repentance and turning to what Allah loves leads to relief. It also stresses that Allah’s mercy is vast and should never be despaired of, while warning against provoking divine wrath and belittling His Awliya’.
